metadata.lastMelbourneGame: 2026-11-24: 9–8 victory at Malvern; box-score player lines pending
metadata.melbournePitchingSourceCaveat: Nov21 Sunshine: 8.0 IP, 19 H, 8 BB, 9 SO, 18 R and 11 ER. Game11 matches 18 runs allowed, but includes 7 unearned; Henry Mcintyre's inning carries 7 R / 1 ER and 4 BB. Historical Game8 Perrett entry provisional. Malvern Nov24 pitching not available.
metadata.melbourneBattingSourceCaveat: Nov21 Sunshine: 35 PA, 33 AB, 9 H, 1 2B, 2 HR, 2 BB, 9 SO, 1 SB. Lennard Pietersz has 4 PA, 4 AB and 1 sacrifice bunt; inconsistent and flagged, not corrected. Older Zak Skinner PA/SAC conflict persists; historical OBP/OPS are estimated.
metadata.melbourneStatPolicy: Official 12 games, player data for 11 supplied games; Nov21 Sunshine loss 18–5 imported once, Nov24 Malvern 9–8 win standings only. Batting AVG qualifies at 24 PA, pitching ERA at 12 outs (4.0 IP). Only AVG and ERA starred.
metadata.sandringhamSourceCaveat: Six-game totals from five-game scouting source plus November 7 4–3 win game rows. OBP/OPS recomputed as estimates using (H+BB)/(AB+BB) due to missing historical HBP/SF/CI. Player game run and earned-run data are not substitutes for ladder runs.
metadata.melbourneOBPMethod: Estimates using H, BB, AB and total bases; full historical HBP/SF/CI incomplete.
metadata.melbourneGame8SourceCaveat: GameDay player table supplied without column headers. PA/AB/R/H, doubles and common BB/SO mappings transcribed provisionally. Perrett pitching 6 IP, 4 H, 7 SO, 1 BB, 0 ER is a provisional interpretation of the row; verify against headed box score. GameDay player row totals do not fully reconcile with team run and hit summary. Ladder score/record authoritative.
